description: Utilities++ keeps your view clean with a per-level height filter for belts and pipes, covering levels 0-9 including pillars. Use Show All/Hide All or cycle layers instantly with PgUp/PgDn without opening the window. The Vehicle Mover tool lets you drag-select vehicles on the map and send them to a new destination in seconds, and more.
description_short: A height filter for belts and pipes by layer with PgUp/PgDn keybinds, plus a Vehicle Mover drag-select tool for relocating vehicles on the map, and more
